title: Ontario: Man's death 'suicide by cop'
article: A coroner's jury has ruled the death of a man shot by police last year was a suicide.
David Melzer, 33, was killed by a police sniper during an 11-hour standoff at his parents' home.

After four weeks of testimony at a coroner's inquiry, the jury ruled Mr. Melzer's actions were consistent with a theory known as "suicide by cop," and agreed he acted in such a way as to force police to kill him.
However, the victim's father, John Melzer, called "suicide by cop" a theory police invented to justify their actions.
